grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 3 UL elements have list-style:none with no role=list — the main nav UL (3 items: Buy/Sell/Agents) and 2 more. In Safari+VoiceOver, list-style:none strips list semantics, so these sets are announced as ungrouped items. Additionally, axe 'listitem' fires on all nav <li> elements because the UL itself has no proper list container context (the outermost nav UL's parent is a DIV with no landmark role). tabWalk speech sequence follows DOM order which is consistent with visual left-to-right top-to-bottom order. No modal background reading issue detected (no modal opened during the walk).
